headline.en: Auto-scaling request handling · Lower resource consumption
headline.zh: 自動增減處理請求・減少資源消耗

1.meaning_en: Serve up to 65% more work and free about 41% of GPU hours.
1.meaning_zh: 多服務最多 65% 的工作，並省下約 41% 的卡小時。

steps.see_en: With 16 users at once, 2 replicas finish 16% to 65% more work than 1 GPU: the longer the input, the bigger the gain.
steps.see_zh: 16 人同時用時，2 個副本比 1 張卡多做 16% 到 65% 的工作：輸入越長，差距越大。

tests.needs_en: What we did: 16 people ask at the same time (32 questions in total). First 1 GPU answers, then 2 GPUs with Ray Serve. We count how much text each produces per second, with short, medium and long questions (1K, 4K, 8K). Quick test, one run each.
tests.needs_zh: 做法：16 個人同時發問（共 32 題）。先用 1 張卡回答，再用 2 張卡加 Ray Serve。數每秒產生多少文字，問題分短、中、長（1K、4K、8K）。快速測試，各跑 1 次。

history.en: 1 GPU direct vs 2 Ray replicas, 16 users: 1101 / 734 / 428 vs 1275 / 1060 / 707 tok/s at 1K / 4K / 8K.

tests.en: 2 GPUs used separately by hand vs Ray Serve
tests.zh: 兩張卡各自手動使用對 Ray Serve
tests.crit_en: Same 16 people: speed and first-word time compared
tests.crit_zh: 同樣 16 人：比較速度與第一個字的時間
tests.needs_en: What we will do: run one copy of the model on each of the 2 GPUs and split the 16 people between them by hand, then run the same people through Ray Serve. This shows what Ray Serve adds on top of simply having 2 GPUs.
tests.needs_zh: 預計做法：兩張卡各跑一份模型，由人手把 16 個人分給兩張卡；再讓同樣的人經過 Ray Serve。看 Ray Serve 在「單純有兩張卡」之上多帶來什麼。

proof.title_zh: 同樣 16 人，問題越來越長
proof.unit_zh: 速度（每秒 token），越高越好
proof.note_en: The longer the question, the more one GPU struggles, and the second one helps.
proof.note_zh: 問題越長，一張卡越吃力，第二張卡的幫助越大。

steps.mean_en: Check a second GPU really takes more users.
steps.mean_zh: 確認第二張卡真的能多扛人。
steps.tip_en: Compared: 1 GPU alone vs 2 GPUs shared by Ray Serve, 16 people asking at once. The extra work comes from the 2nd GPU; Ray Serve shares the questions between the two automatically. Not yet compared with 2 GPUs used separately by hand: that is a next test.
steps.tip_zh: 比較對象：1 張卡單獨回答，對 2 張卡由 Ray Serve 分工，16 人同時發問。多做的工作來自多一張卡；Ray Serve 負責把問題自動分給兩張卡。還沒和「兩張卡各自手動使用」比，那是下一個測試。

steps.see_en: Replicas go up under load and back down when idle: nobody adds servers by hand.
steps.see_zh: 負載大時自動增加、閒時縮回：不用人手加機器。

tests.zh: 用 10 分鐘實測換算卡小時
tests.crit_en: Count the GPUs held every 5 s, then scale to a day, week and month
tests.crit_zh: 每 5 秒記錄佔用幾張卡，再換算成一天、一週、一個月
tests.needs_en: What we did: during the 10-minute run (6 min busy, 4 min quiet) we counted the GPUs in use every 5 s: 1 GPU while quiet (191 s), 2 while busy (363 s), and the 2nd GPU stayed 70 s after the busy time ended. Then we multiplied those rates by the scenario hours.
tests.needs_zh: 做法：10 分鐘實測（忙 6 分鐘、閒 4 分鐘）每 5 秒記錄用了幾張卡：閒時 1 張（191 秒）、忙時 2 張（363 秒），忙完後第 2 張還多留 70 秒。再把這些比率乘上情境的時數。
tests.result_en: Held 1052 GPU-seconds, against 1248 when 2 GPUs are always on (-16% in this sample; more when quiet lasts longer)
tests.result_zh: 共佔用 1052 卡秒，固定開 2 張是 1248（這個樣本 -16%；閒的時間越長省越多）

steps.mean_en: Check the GPUs in use follow the number of users.
steps.mean_zh: 確認用幾張卡跟著人數走。
steps.sum_en: 138 GPU-hours a week freed for others.
steps.sum_zh: 每週省 138 卡小時給別人用。

proof.title_en: If people use it like an office day
proof.title_zh: 如果像上班日一樣使用
proof.unit_en: GPU-hours, lower is better. Checked every 30 minutes.
proof.unit_zh: 卡小時，越低越好。每 30 分鐘檢查一次。
proof.note_en: Savings add up: about 591 GPU-hours a month, a whole GPU free for 25 days, about 7,200 a year. Our assumption, not measured: 2 GPUs needed 6 h on weekdays (09-12, 14-17), otherwise 1. Measured: it reacts in about 100 s.
proof.note_zh: 省下的卡小時會累積：一個月約 591 小時，等於一張卡空出 25 天；一年約 7,200 小時。我們的假設，非實測：平日 6 小時需 2 張卡，其餘 1 張。實測：約 100 秒內會跟上。
notes: Sample (measured, 10 min): quiet holds 1 GPU, busy holds 2, and the 2nd stays 70 s after busy ends.
樣本（實測 10 分鐘）：閒時佔 1 張卡、忙時 2 張，忙完後第 2 張多留 70 秒。
Multiplier: if weekdays have 6 busy hours (09-12, 14-17), a week is 5 x (18 x 1 + 6 x 2) + 2 x 24 = 198 GPU-hours, against 336 always on 2 GPUs.
Benefit: 138 GPU-hours saved a week (-41%); 591 a month, one GPU free for 25 days.
效益：每週省 138 卡小時（-41%）；一個月 591，一張卡空出 25 天。

items: Start: GPT-OSS-20B on Ray Serve with 1 GPU, allowed to grow to 2.
開始：GPT-OSS-20B 跑在 Ray Serve，1 張卡，最多可增加到 2 張。
Busy: 16 simulated users keep asking for 6 minutes.
忙：16 個模擬使用者連續發問 6 分鐘。
Grow: after 10 s Ray Serve starts a 2nd GPU copy; it answers requests after 101 s.
擴：10 秒後開始加第 2 張卡，101 秒後可以回答。
Quiet: users stop for 4 minutes; after 76 s the 2nd GPU is given back.
閒：使用者停 4 分鐘，76 秒後自動把第 2 張卡還出來。
Check: 8489 requests were sent, none failed.
檢查：共送出 8489 個請求，沒有失敗。

steps.tip_en: From the measured 10-minute run (GPUs counted every 5 s: 1 when quiet, 2 when busy, 70 s extra after busy), multiplied by the scenario of 6 busy hours on weekdays: 198 GPU-hours a week instead of 336, so 138 saved (-41%).
steps.tip_zh: 來自 10 分鐘實測（每 5 秒記錄：閒 1 張、忙 2 張、忙完多留 70 秒），乘上平日忙 6 小時的情境：一週 198 卡小時，固定開 2 張是 336，省 138（-41%）。

steps.see_en: Almost free: speed only drops 1.3%, the first word comes 34 ms later.
steps.see_zh: 幾乎沒有代價：速度只掉 1.3%，第一個字晚 34 毫秒出現。

tests.crit_en: Scales up under load, down when idle, 0 failed requests
tests.crit_zh: 負載大時增加、閒時縮回，失敗為 0
tests.needs_en: What we did: 16 people keep asking for 6 minutes, then stop for 4 minutes. We watch whether Ray Serve adds a 2nd GPU when it is busy and gives it back when it is quiet. Quick test, one run.
tests.needs_zh: 做法：16 個人連續發問 6 分鐘，再停 4 分鐘。看 Ray Serve 忙的時候會不會加第 2 張卡、閒下來會不會還回去。快速測試，跑 1 次。
tests.result_en: Passed: 2nd replica started 10 s after the load began and was ready after 101 s; back to 1 replica 76 s after the load stopped; 8489 requests, 0 failed
tests.result_zh: 通過：負載開始 10 秒後啟動第 2 個副本、101 秒後可用；負載停止 76 秒後縮回 1 個；8489 個請求，0 個失敗

history.en: Run 1 failed (CUDA driver error on the second replica). Run 2 with compile cache off: up in 101 s, down in 76 s, 0 failed.
history.zh: 第 1 次失敗（第 2 個副本 CUDA 錯誤）。第 2 次關掉編譯快取：101 秒擴、76 秒縮、0 失敗。

tests.crit_en: TPS loss at most 10%; TTFT / TPOT difference reported
tests.crit_zh: 總吞吐損失不超過 10%；回報 TTFT、TPOT 差距
tests.needs_en: What we did: asked the same model the same questions twice, once straight to vLLM and once through Ray Serve, 3 times each, on 1 GPU. Then we compared the speed. Quick test, not a formal one.
tests.needs_zh: 做法：同一個模型、同樣的問題，問兩次：一次直接問 vLLM，一次經過 Ray Serve，各 3 輪，用 1 張卡。比較速度。這是快速測試，不是正式測試。

history.en: Direct: 152.2 / 135.5 / 146.9 tok/s. Ray Serve: 150.1 / 134.6 / 144.1 tok/s. Loss 1.3%, passed.

tests.result_en: Passed: TPS 142.9 vs 144.8 direct (-1.3%); TTFT +34 ms (169 to 203); TPOT 4.85 vs 4.96 ms

steps.mean_en: Check a new GPU starts by itself, with nobody watching.
steps.mean_zh: 確認新增一張卡不用人盯，會自己開起來。
steps.sum_en: Ready in 101 s; by hand it waits for the next check.
steps.sum_zh: 101 秒就緒；人手要等下一次檢查。
steps.tip_en: From the autoscale run: 16 people started asking, Ray Serve began adding a GPU after 10 s and the new GPU answered after 101 s. By hand: if someone checks every 30 minutes, a new GPU waits 15 minutes on average.
steps.tip_zh: 來自自動增減實測：16 人開始發問，Ray Serve 10 秒後開始加卡，新卡 101 秒後開始回答。人手：若每 30 分鐘檢查一次，新增一張卡平均等 15 分鐘。

items: By hand: if someone checks every 30 min, a new GPU waits 15 min on average, up to 30.
人手：若每 30 分鐘檢查一次，新增一張卡平均等 15 分鐘，最久 30 分鐘。
Ray Serve (measured): starts adding a GPU in 10 s, it answers after 101 s, and it is given back 76 s after things go quiet.
Ray Serve（實測）：10 秒開始加卡，101 秒後可回答，閒下來 76 秒後自動還卡。
Reference: AWS reports 30-50% lower cost from auto scaling, so our -41% is in the same range.
參考：AWS 報告自動增減可降 30–50% 成本，我們的 -41% 落在同一範圍。
https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/amazon-dynamodb-auto-scaling-performance-and-cost-optimization-at-any-scale/
AWS

steps.supp_en: Supplement: going through Ray Serve is 1.3% slower than vLLM direct (142.9 vs 144.8 tokens/s, 3 repeats).
steps.supp_zh: 補充：經過 Ray Serve 比直接用 vLLM 慢 1.3%（每秒 142.9 對 144.8 token，重複 3 輪）。

2.meaning_en: Should it join our stack? Find its limit and see how it sits next to LiteLLM.
2.meaning_zh: 要不要放進我們的架構？找出極限，並確認它和 LiteLLM 怎麼搭。

steps.see_en: The load at which it stops getting faster: how many users one setup can take.
steps.see_zh: 負載到哪裡就不再變快：一套設定最多能服務多少人。

tests.needs_en: Finds where Ray Serve or the GPU saturates.
tests.needs_zh: 找出 Ray Serve 或 GPU 的飽和點。

steps.mean_zh: 找出一套設定最多服務多少人。
steps.sum_en: The load where it stops getting faster.

tests.crit_en: Same backends: throughput and p95 TTFT compared
tests.crit_zh: 同樣後端：比較吞吐與 p95 TTFT
tests.needs_en: Shows what each layer adds on the same load.
tests.needs_zh: 同一負載下看兩層各自帶來什麼。

steps.sum_zh: 同一負載下多帶來什麼。

steps.see_zh: 一個請求走完 LiteLLM → Ray Serve → vLLM。接著決定：採用或不採用。
